title: Ruthless Bar Salts Blue Razz Strawzz 10ml E-Liquid
description: Ruthless Bar Salts Blue Razz Strawzz delivers a dynamic mix of tart Blue Raspberry and sweet Strawberries, creating a bold and fruity vape with a perfect balance of tangy and juicy notes. The sharpness of Blue Raspberry comes through first, offering a bright, mouthwatering tang, followed by the soft, jammy sweetness of ripe Strawberries for a smooth and flavourful exhale. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this e-liquid is designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits and starter devices, ensuring a smooth and consistent vape with satisfying vapour production. The nicotine salt formulation provides a comfortable throat hit and rapid nicotine absorption, making it an excellent choice for vapers who enjoy fruit-forward profiles with a vibrant edge. Ruthless is one of the most influential brands in American e-liquids, known for crafting bold and unique flavours that have inspired the industry for years. Their expertly blended shortfills and nic salts continue to be a favourite among vapers on both sides of the pond who prize high-quality, distinct, and flavourful e-liquids that push the boundaries of what’s possible in vape juice.
